results.name: verify_and_contract_tests
results.details: 3/3 CTest suites passed; contract fixture covered invalid no-op observations, slow-clock adaptation, bounded drift, corrected source step and process boundary, reset recovery, and fan-out isolation for an addressed enabled sink.

limitations: Deterministic synthetic user-space evidence only; no COM/audio/device/thread waits were introduced.
This is not real USB/HDMI/Bluetooth clock evidence, WaveRT evidence, HLK evidence, Microsoft signing evidence, or physical-audio delivery evidence.
